tier.why: S1 has no fitted weights: every day before the freeze is weights-clean (T0 after it)
tier.selection: the served model (ICON, 2026-09-30) was chosen on 2024-02 → 2026-08 (protocol §2 decision log): a served-vs-candidate S1 comparison on this window favours the incumbent

primary.rule: the 90% CI of ΔMAE (model − served) excludes 0 (protocol §8)
primary.multiplicity: Holm across the candidate models (protocol §6: simultaneous candidate claims), on the two-sided bootstrap p of ΔMAE at α = 0.10, the 90% CI's level

why_own_differs.note: S1 scores each model on every day it holds, 2024-01-20 to the data end; the report scores all three on the days all three hold, 2024-02-03 to 2026-08-27
